_comment: mmLinearGauge in full - all five functions, so nothing of the class stays in game.asm.
Not polymorphic: the destructor mangles ??1mmLinearGauge@@QAE@XZ, `Q` for public non-virtual,
and there is no vftable, so none of the handover machinery is involved.
?nodeGetBitmap@@YAPAVgfxBitmap@@PBD_N1@Z is NOT listed. Init only CALLS it; it is declared
ARTS_IMPORT in misc/freefuncs.h so the linker resolves it against the PROC still in game.asm.
